<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Moody Turtle 89</title>
<style>
/* Moody Turtle 89 by ahmed150up — https://uiverse.io/ahmed150up/moody-turtle-89 */
.btn-save {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  padding: 10px 20px;
  border: none;
  border-radius: 4px;
  background-color: #f2f2f2;
  color: #333;
  font-size: 16px;
  font-weight: bold;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: background-color 0.3s ease;
}

.btn-save:hover {
  background-color: #ddd;
}

.icon {
  width: 24px;
  height: 24px;
  margin-right: 8px;
}

.icon-path {
  fill: #333;
  transition: fill 0.3s ease;
}

.btn-save:hover .icon-path {
  fill: #888;
}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<button class="btn-save">

  </button>
